| description = Named cyclops in East Karana. He is the Father of [[Broon]] and [[Droon]] (unrelated to [[Choon]]?).

When Broon is killed, the spawn of either [[Droon]] or [[Proon]] is randomly triggered. The exact chance of either is not known, but [[Droon]] seems more likely.

Proon will come walking down from the mountains south towards the druid ring to about (1200, 500, 0). He then paths SE to about (800, -20, 0), then heads west back towards the shore to about (700, 460, 0), then back north to the original spot near druid ring.

An angry cyclops father searching for the one who killed his poor little son.
